faqs.question: Does the policy cover normal delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes, normal delivery is generally covered subject to policy terms.

faqs.question: Does the policy cover C-section delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes, C-section expenses are usually covered.

faqs.question: Is newborn baby coverage included?
faqs.answer: Many maternity plans provide newborn coverage.

faqs.question: Is there a waiting period?
faqs.answer: Most maternity plans have a waiting period before benefits can be claimed.

faqs.question: Can pregnancy complications be covered?
faqs.answer: Coverage depends on policy conditions and insurer guidelines.
